category: digital goods: books, movies, music
assumption: Unmatched mixed digital publishing distribution and streaming.

category: artist supply and craft shops
assumption: Assume artist materials dominate finished craft goods for CABEE.

category: computer programming, data processing, and integrated systems design services
assumption: Computer systems services; no consumer-price proxy.

category: shoe shops
assumption: Footwear retail.

category: furniture, home furnishings and equipment shops, and manufacturers, except appliances
assumption: Assume furniture retail dominates manufacturing and other furnishings.

category: gift, card, novelty, and souvenir shops
assumption: Broad other-store retail includes gift and card goods.

category: computers, computer peripheral equipment, and software
assumption: Assume computer hardware retail dominates software services; CPI also contains audio-visual goods.

category: florists supplies, nursery stock, and flowers
assumption: Search proxy assumes flower retail dominates nursery and wholesale activity.

category: tent and awning shops
assumption: Unmatched mixed camping and building-related goods.

category: cable, satellite, and other pay television and radio services
assumption: CPI media-services proxy is broader than subscription broadcasting.

category: watch, clock, and jewelry repair shops
assumption: Repair industry includes other goods; watch searches proxy mixed repairs.

category: bicycle shops - sales and service
assumption: Assume bicycle sales dominate repairs; CPI also includes sports and camping goods.

category: music shops - musical instruments, pianos, and sheet music
assumption: Assume instrument retail dominates sheet-music sales.

category: books, periodicals, and newspapers
assumption: CPI includes stationery; search proxy focuses on books.

category: health and beauty spas
assumption: Assume beauty and grooming dominate health treatments.

category: stationery, office supplies and printing and writing paper
assumption: Assume stationery retail dominates wholesale; CPI includes newspapers and magazines.

category: lawn and garden supply outlets, including nurseries
assumption: Garden supply retail; no single CPI class covers both plants and tools.

category: motor vehicle supplies and new parts
assumption: Motor vehicle parts retail.

category: opticians, optical goods, and eyeglasses
assumption: CPI covers therapeutic goods beyond eyewear; search term emphasizes clinical services.

category: hobby, toy and game shops
assumption: Assume physical toys and games dominate other hobby and computer-game retail.

category: equipment, tool, furniture, and appliance rent al and leasing
assumption: Assume ordinary goods rental dominates heavy machinery and scaffolding.

category: antique shops - sales, repairs, and restoration services
assumption: Assume antique sales dominate restoration and repairs.

category: telecom
assumption: CPI is household telecom; CABEE combines national counts for all three telecom classes.

category: art dealers and galleries
assumption: Assume retail art sales dominate public gallery and admission activity.

category: jewelry, watch, clock, and silverware shops
assumption: Assume jewellery and watches dominate clocks and silverware.
